name: Epi25 whole-exome sequencing

access.licence: Browser downloads open; dbGaP disease-specific consent (DS-EPSBA…-MDS-RD), NHGRI DAC
access.steps: Gene/variant results: direct download. Exomes: dbGaP Authorized Access request, data on AnVIL.

cohort.types: GGE, non-acquired focal epilepsy, developmental and epileptic encephalopathies, lesional focal

format: Gene results TSV; variant results TSV/VCF; dbGaP individual data
caveats: dbGaP holds 12,890 consented subjects, not all 20,979
No imaging or EEG: link to the virtual brain is indirect
checks: Nature Neurosci. abstract; Epi25 browser downloads page; dbGaP study page.
pipeline: Genetic prior for a 'mechanism' agent (e.g. ion-channel genes → excitability parameters). Low priority for the virtual-brain build.
key_claim: Exome summary statistics for 20,979 cases / 33,444 controls are open; individual exomes need dbGaP approval.

evidence.quote: comprising 20,979 deeply phenotyped patients from multiple genetic ancestry groups with diverse epilepsy subtypes and 33,444 controls
